Original mechanism: read W001-orders.md Card C and its ranking/protocol in FULL. Build a classical tensor/constraint representation of Shor output marginals using only N and a unit base a. Construct modular exponentiation, trace the work output, perform justified local paired-arithmetic cancellations, then use a fully specified min-fill elimination order (creation-index tie break). A polynomial method would need actual intermediate width O(log n), controlled precision and useful splitting probability, with planning and all arithmetic charged. Large whole-state Schmidt rank does not prove a scalar marginal hard; conversely rewriting a sum using an unknown order does not compute it. Quantum simulation itself is prior art, not a new reduction.

NEW focused task H010: implement or mathematically reject ONE precise structural-width route, not a full amplitude simulator. Choose and fully specify an N-only ripple-carry modular multiplier/exponentiation network with explicit reductions and bit-level constraints; no giant arithmetic gate counted as constant width. Validate its function and the legality of cancellations on a small exhaustive mathematical domain before relying on graph widths. A doubled deterministic constraint network is acceptable if you derive exactly which probability it represents and include any prefix-measurement couplings; a graph omitting those is not the proposed sampler. Rejecting a restricted representation/order is not a generic simulation lower bound.

Original finite screen recommendation: n=8,12,16,20, three distinct balanced semiprimes per size, seed1002, two unit bases per N, every prefix length for an all-zero semiclassical history. Cap w at 2*ceil(log2(n))+4. Freeze the actual circuit choice, bit order, cancellation rules, tie breaking, case IDs, rejection threshold and <=60-second external run cap BEFORE execution; preserve all incomplete and unstarted cases. If implementing that exact grid is not warranted because a structural proof already rejects the chosen representation, derive the proof instead and explicitly state no experiment. Do not keep enlarging time limits or switch circuit after seeing a bad width under the same preregistration.

Crucial: all-zero output can admit extra cancellations; no claim that passing one history proves all histories. A failed width for this order does not establish large optimal treewidth. Planning cost can itself fail. Classical arithmetic constraints must reproduce a reversible clean computation's probability rather than accidentally summing over garbage assignments. No factors, orders, factor-size labels, or order-specific compiled gates reach the candidate. Exact Boolean arithmetic and structural tests only; no unjustified numerical simulation.

Deliver exact representation/cost, verified function/cancellation evidence, full width outcomes or a self-contained restricted obstruction, and one concrete changed representation if a route survives. Primary technical prior art must be checked via web. Existing W001 failures: raw-bit n² recurrence bound failed 59/60 cases, random-sign Fourier sparse support failed its moment screen, sparse order products are dense before component order. Do not retry those under new names. The active H006/H008 reviews concern unrelated polynomial relaxations/resultants and should not be duplicated. No broad survey; decide the one specified structural question.
